author: Aeolan
quote:
GTA 6 was sold on the idea of being the biggest and most ambitious entry in the series, and it doesn't live up to that, this is me trying so say in a nice way how much of a slop this is. 

The world feels limited and restricted where earlier GTA games felt open and anarchic. The freedom, edge and sense of chaos that defined the franchise are largely missing, and the game has surprisingly little to no connection to what made previous GTA titles timeless. For a studio with Rockstar's track record, this is proof how disconnected they are and that they lost their spine. 

It feels like a studio that has lost touch with its own identity and with the players who made the series what it is. This is a pink game made by pink people who want to play a pink sim.

A critic score of 99 is IMPOSSIBLE to take seriously. It shows how far professional reviews have drifted from what actual players experience. Corrupt garbage, disgrace for the community. I hope it burns into the ground. No need to fix it. Please die fast.
